tools.description: Resolve an address, Valjú UUID/reference or source:listing_id. Ask the user to choose when ambiguous.
tools.name: resolve_property

tools.description: Return factual property details and current asking price for a canonical Valjú UUID.
tools.name: get_property

tools.description: Search current listings with structured filters. Results are paginated; total is the full number of matches, while items contains only the requested page. Common Icelandic municipality names are normalized to official names. Prices are asking prices in ISK.
tools.name: search_listings

total.description: Total number of current listings matching the filters, not just this page.

tools.description: Return chronological listing, asking-price and recorded transaction events; removal does not prove a sale.
tools.name: get_property_history

tools.description: Return ordered image metadata and public image URLs for a Valjú listing ID. An empty images array means no images are available for that listing.
tools.name: get_listing_images

tools.description: Search valid single-property recorded transactions. Prices are recorded sale prices in ISK.
tools.name: search_sales

tools.description: Return deterministically ranked nearby comparable transactions; scores are similarity, not confidence.
tools.name: get_comparables

tools.description: Run and return a live Valjú price estimate using current property features and market index data. The response identifies today's calculation date; unavailable interval or model metadata is null.
tools.name: get_valuation

tools.description: Return auditable segment-v2 transaction medians and canonical unique-property inventory. Common municipality aliases are normalized. The response includes calculation date, applied filters, source-advertisement coverage, exclusion counts, methodology, and reasons for unavailable metrics.
tools.name: get_market_stats
